Mark, welcome! Come in. This is the waiting room. It's small, but it's cozy.
Thanks for showing me around before my flight back to Miami. It's lovely, and it's spotless. How many patients come here in a day?
About twelve. There are only four chairs, so it gets a little cramped at four o'clock. But there's plenty of coffee, and there are a couple of magazines in English.
In English? Are there many foreign patients here?
Not many, but there are a few, and there are more every year. Come and see my consulting room. There's a big window, so there's a lot of light.
Very nice. Is there any space for a second chair?
Not really. There isn't much space at all. My supplies are in these drawers, and there are some boxes on the shelf over there.
Then you're just like me. At my practice there are three dentists and only two rooms, and we always run out of gloves on a Friday.
Excuse me, there aren't any towels in my room.

My mother and I are going to Orlando in March, so last night I finally booked an apartment. Here is what we are getting. There are two bedrooms, which is perfect, because my mother goes to bed at nine and I don't. There is a small kitchen with a coffee machine, but there isn't a dishwasher, so we are going to eat out a lot. There are a couple of supermarkets near the building, and there is plenty of space on the balcony for breakfast. Now, the bad news. There is only one bathroom, and there isn't much space in it. The reviews also say that there aren't many towels, so I am packing a few of my own. And there is no elevator. We are on the second floor, so that is fine for us, but my mother has a very big suitcase. I think I know who is carrying it.

Hello, and welcome to the Bayview Hotel. Here is a short guide to your room. There is a safe in the closet, and there are two bottles of water on the desk. Those are free. The drinks in the minibar are not. There is an iron in every room, but there isn't a hair dryer, so if you need one, just call the front desk and we can bring one up. There are plenty of pool towels at the pool bar, so please don't take the towels from your bathroom. There is no coffee machine in the room, but there is a lot of free coffee in the lobby from six to ten every morning. And one last thing: there aren't any parking spaces at the hotel, but there are a few in the building next door, for twenty dollars a day. If anything is missing in your room, give us a call. Enjoy your stay.
